preamble: Deglottalization of the alveolar ejective affricate [tsʼ] to plain [ts]. Stem-final Proto-Athabaskan *tsʼ lost its glottalization in Lower Tanana and Tanacross. Ashkenazi and Israeli Hebrew [ts] for Proto-Semitic emphatic *ṣ (reconstructed as *tsʼ) is filed in two steps, *tsʼ > sˤ and sˤ > ts, following Wikipedia's account that Biblical sˤ was de-pharyngealized and affricated; Steiner (1982) and Kogan (2011: 62–63) argue instead that Hebrew kept an old affricate, which would make it a direct case of this change.
